docs.title: MathEngine v1.0
docs.text: Advanced and optimized computational engine in C# designed for zero-allocation performance and maximum precision.

docs.title: Core Features
docs.text: -   :material-flash:{ .lg .middle } **High Performance**      ---     Engineered for heavy numerical computations with zero overhead and minimal garbage collection pressure.  -   :material-engine:{ .lg .middle } **Modular Architecture**      ---     Structured within the `Math.Engine.Core` namespace with high extensibility for advanced mathematical modules.  -   :material-book-open-page-variant:{ .lg .middle } **Transparent R&D Documentation**      ---     Step-by-step engineering records featuring rigorous algorithm design, mathematical proofs, and benchmarks.
